title: The Infinitesimal of the Third Order, From Under the Forehead, Over the Railing
source: Yevgeny Zamyatin, We, Record Nineteen, Gregory Zilboorg 1924 translation; original interpretive dialogue
content_note: Non-graphic reference to fatal industrial accident and reproductive coercion by the One State

scenes.title: 01 · A Test That Does Not Stop
scenes.speaker: SECOND BUILDER · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: The Integral's motor has fired. The work continues.
scenes.story: On the day I-330 promised to meet D-503, the Integral's newly mounted motor is tested. Its first blast kills about a dozen people standing near the exhaust. The surviving workers continue their jobs. D-503 celebrates the lack of interruption.
scenes.observation: An engine test kills approximately a dozen people and production continues.
scenes.inference: Smooth production proves that the loss of human life is unimportant.
scenes.question: What must a witness preserve?
choices: Each death remains a human loss regardless of the population fraction.
The casualties are morally insignificant because the rate is small.
reply: Correct: this interpretation preserves the event and its uncertainty.
This asserts an unverified result that Record Nineteen does not establish.

scenes.title: 02 · A Third-Order Infinitesimal
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: What are a dozen lives against the whole State? That is how I have been taught to count.
scenes.story: D-503 treats the victims as a tiny numerical fraction of the One State and derides pity. This is his rationalization, not a mathematical law of ethics. His thoughts quickly return to anticipation of I-330.
scenes.observation: D-503 describes the deaths through a population fraction and shows little grief.
scenes.inference: A small proportion establishes a small moral cost.
scenes.question: Which quantity has been collapsed improperly?
choices: Individual losses have been replaced by a population statistic.
The literal magnitude of the fraction.
reply: Correct: this interpretation preserves the event and its uncertainty.
This asserts an unverified result that Record Nineteen does not establish.

scenes.title: 03 · The Man Under the Forehead
scenes.speaker: MESSENGER · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: She asked you to follow the enclosed instructions exactly.
scenes.story: At sixteen D-503 waits in his glass room for I-330. A stranger with a sloping forehead arrives instead, handing him a note and a pink ticket. The ticket authorizes an apparent visit by I-330, but she is absent.
scenes.observation: A messenger delivers a note and ticket; I-330 does not appear.
scenes.inference: A valid pink ticket proves the named person physically attended.
scenes.question: What do the documents demonstrate?
choices: A scheduled visit can be represented without actual presence.
The identity and objectives of everyone watching.
reply: Correct: this interpretation preserves the event and its uncertainty.
This asserts an unverified result that Record Nineteen does not establish.

scenes.title: 04 · A Performance Behind Glass
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: She wants the curtains lowered as if she were here. I tear the note, yet keep her ticket.
scenes.story: The note tells D-503 to lower the curtains as though I-330 is visiting so unnamed observers will be deceived. He tears the note apart, nearly destroys the ticket, then leaves it on the table. His compliance is undecided for now.
scenes.observation: The note directs deception; D-503 tears it and retains the ticket.
scenes.inference: Keeping a document alone proves all requested actions have already occurred.
scenes.question: Which event is still pending?
choices: Whether he will lower the curtains and perform the false appearance.
reply: Correct: this interpretation preserves the event and its uncertainty.
This asserts an unverified result that Record Nineteen does not establish.

scenes.title: 05 · Over the Edge of the Platform
scenes.speaker: NARRATOR · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: A child slips toward the platform's edge. One person leaps before anyone else.
scenes.story: In Auditorium 13, a compulsory lecture about reproduction uses a small child as a demonstration. The child leans toward a dangerous edge. O-90 rushes forward, catches it, places it safely back, and kisses its wrist. D-503 recognizes her.
scenes.observation: The child is in danger, and O-90 intervenes immediately.
scenes.inference: Her rescue alone proves every future decision she will make.
scenes.question: What is confirmed?
choices: A protective act, followed by her visible tenderness.
A confirmed pregnancy or an official parenting authorization.
reply: Correct: this interpretation preserves the event and its uncertainty.
This asserts an unverified result that Record Nineteen does not establish.

scenes.title: 06 · The Answer O-90 Demands
scenes.speaker: O-90 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: I wanted to leave you in peace. But there is one thing I still want.
scenes.story: D-503 returns home and finds O-90 waiting. She asks for his answer to her farewell letter. He responds coldly and delays while she cries. Then she reveals that she wants a child with him despite State rules that make unauthorized motherhood dangerous.
scenes.observation: O-90 asks directly for a child despite knowing the risk, and D-503 responds with cruelty before the request.
scenes.inference: Her desire proves that a pregnancy has already begun or that the danger has ended.
scenes.question: What belongs in the record?
choices: A declared wish and the acknowledged risk, not a completed pregnancy.
A demonstrated outcome that the novel has not yet supplied.
reply: Correct: this interpretation preserves the event and its uncertainty.
This asserts an unverified result that Record Nineteen does not establish.

scenes.title: 07 · The Ticket Used for Someone Else
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: The ticket was hers. The woman before me was O-90. I crossed the boundary anyway.
scenes.story: D-503 remembers O-90's tenderness toward the child and takes I-330's pink ticket downstairs to arrange the curtains. O-90 realizes whose ticket he is using, which adds to her pain. Their ensuing intimacy is conveyed non-graphically, while D-503 describes his decision as jumping over a high railing. No pregnancy is confirmed.
scenes.observation: D-503 uses I-330's authorization for O-90 and they become intimate despite the dangerous conditions.
scenes.inference: The act proves pregnancy or renders O-90's independent consent and future fate irrelevant.
scenes.question: What should W020 retain?
choices: An intentional breach, O-90's stated desire, and an unresolved consequence.
A confirmed child or a guaranteed outcome.
reply: Correct: this interpretation preserves the event and its uncertainty.
This asserts an unverified result that Record Nineteen does not establish.
